born.why: The code prioritizes starvation avoidance by eating unknown food if hunger is critical (>80), uses a "mostly poisoned" heuristic to reject recurring bad fruits, and distinguishes between novel exploration (taste when moderately hungry) and known good foods (carry/eat), ensuring survival while maintaining dietary variety.
